title: Croissant Pack
description: Mod pack for TechMC that contains a lot of useful mods.
body:
# 🛠️ Croissant Pack **Croissant Pack** is designed for **TMC-style technical Minecraft gameplay**. This pack focuses on **efficiency, control, and performance**, making it ideal for redstone engineers, automation lovers, and technical players. ## ⚙️ Loader - 🧵 **Fabric** ## 📦 Included Mods This modpack is built around a clean and powerful core: - 🧠 **Masa Mods** Essential tools for technical gameplay, including visualization, planning, and debugging. - 🟥 **Carpet Mod** Advanced game rule control and technical testing features widely used in TMC environments. - 🚀 **Optimization Mods** Various performance-focused mods to improve FPS, reduce lag, and ensure smooth gameplay even in complex worlds. ## 🧩 Mod List(1.21.11)
